mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article(title, content, article_abstract, author_id, author_username, catalog_id, catalog_name, last_modified) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{articleAbstract}, #{authorId}, #{authorUsername}, #{catalogId}, #{catalogName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM article WHERE author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY last_modified DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM article ORDER BY last_modified DESC, id DESC
SELECT author_id FROM article WHERE id = #{articleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE catalog_id = #{catalogId}
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET author_username = #{username} WHERE author_id = #{authorId}
